title: When Your Shoplifting Plan Ends in Disaster
description:
► LAS Concealment
https://lasconcealment.com/ 

On May 22, 2023, officers responded to a disturbance at Farm and Fleet in Onalaska, WI, involving a male and female threatening employees. Upon arrival, the female attempted to flee with stolen merchandise but was quickly caught. The suspects were under suspicion for prior thefts at the store and the female suspect later admitted to stealing products to sell for cash. Prior to this incident, she had faced roughly 16 theft charges, with convictions in several cases. Following this particular incident, the female has been arrested on three more occasions for retail theft, credit card fraud, and bail jumping. So in other words, she's not stopping.
